corsApiBlocking.description: External API https://api.islamic.app does not provide Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers for the preview web origin http://15.235.203.134:9998, causing all network fetches to fail at browser client level.
corsApiBlocking.evidence: Browser console logs show CORS policy ERR_FAILED on /v1/timings, /v1/verses, /v1/hadith.

offlineWebLoadability.description: No Service Worker or CacheStorage is deployed on the web target (insecure HTTP context prohibits serviceWorker registration, and no sw.js exists); cold boot or page refresh while offline results in net::ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED.
offlineWebLoadability.evidence: runtimeResults.offlineReloadRuns shows ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED across all runs.
